title: Multiplication column for a cons list
statement: For a bit $t$, bit strings $a,b$, and $j\in\mathbb{N}$, the multiplication-column sum for the list beginning with $t$ and continuing with $a$ equals $t$ times the $j$th bit of $b$, plus zero when $j=0$, and otherwise the multiplication-column sum for $a,b$ at index $j-1$. Missing list entries are treated as zero.
